name: Qu8k
coast_note: burnout ~10.7 s but the Q-18,000 tail-off suppresses apparent drag into ~13.5 s; past 30 s (>60 kft) the drag reading approaches the 0.1 G quantization step

trace.accel_convention: specific force in G: +1.0 at rest on the pad, ~0 in free coast

apogee_note: accelerometer-integrated path length; Deville corrects to 120,926 ft vertical for the 2.2 mi horizontal offset
sources: Qu8k - The Story (Deville, 2011), p.30 weight table
weights_note: 154.5 lb is the rocket WEIGHED right after the flight (Qu8k - The Story, p.30 measured column); GLOW 314.5, propellant 160. Earlier 320/153/167 figures were from the archived spec page and are superseded.
